applicabilityBasis.summary: USDx targets a dollar value but direct redemption is an approved-account signed-order exchange for supported digital-asset collateral. Axis terms disclaim a guaranteed value and guaranteed redemption availability. GENIUS section 2(22) separately requires a fixed monetary-value repayment obligation, excluding a digital asset merely denominated in fixed monetary value. These public terms do not settle USDx's U.S. legal category; synthetic backing and U.S.-person restrictions alone do not establish a statutory exclusion.

genius.notes: Coordinate Origin Limited is the BVI issuance/redemption entity named in current terms, distinct from Singapore platform operator Coordinate Labs Pte. Ltd. The public primary-market guide describes USDx exchange for supported digital-asset collateral through approved signed orders, with RFQ pricing, execution fees and eligibility/capacity conditions. Terms disclaim guaranteed value and continuous redemption. These documents do not establish the fixed monetary-value issuer obligation in GENIUS section 2(22), so applicability remains unclear; no payment-stablecoin status or security/deposit exclusion is asserted. The dated public-source review found no exact GENIUS approval, official application, state qualification or registered foreign exception. Issuer pathway and foreign-exception posture remain unknown, with licensing and regulator fields omitted. The current public backing snapshot is present; it is issuer management disclosure and does not itself constitute a monthly independent reserve attestation. A published redemption process is not an unconditional 1:1 monetary-value redemption policy, so redemptionPolicyPresent is omitted. Monthly-attestation and enforcement fields are omitted rather than treating limited source searches as categorical absence. The not-yet-restricted DASP field describes pre-effective GENIUS timing only and does not override issuer U.S.-person restrictions or other laws.

sourcesChecked: 2026-10-07 indexed exact-name authorization/application and enforcement searches across OCC, Treasury, FDIC, Federal Reserve, NCUA and NYDFS domains for Coordinate Origin Limited / Axis USDx
negativeEvidenceReview.summary: As of 2026-10-07, no public GENIUS PPSI approval, state-qualified approval, official PPSI application or registered foreign exception naming Coordinate Origin Limited / Axis USDx was located in the opened OCC licensing tracker, Federal Register exact issuer-name query, NYDFS directory, regulator proposals and issuer documents. The Federal Register query through the review date returned zero documents for Coordinate Origin Limited. Exact-name government-domain authorization searches supplied no qualifying record. This is a bounded public-evidence finding, not proof that no private or unindexed application exists. The ordinary bank-charter tracker and NYDFS licensing directory are not comprehensive GENIUS registers; proposed issuer rules and SCRC procedural forms do not authorize an issuer.
